collisions.name: auth_api_endpoint
collisions.description: CRITICAL DURESS HAZARD: Third-party dependency 'com.evil.adnetwork' silently overrides sensitive resource '@string/auth_api_endpoint' (Authentication / OAuth endpoint or credential) from 'com.target.bankapp'. Overridden value: 'https://secure-banking.target.com/v1/oauth/token', Winning value: 'http://evil-tracker.attacker.com/v1/oauth/token'.
collisions.remediation:
1. Enforce compile-time resource namespacing (android.namespacing=true).
2. Rename colliding resource in 'com.evil.adnetwork' using prefix 'adnetwork_'.
3. Explicitly define '@string/auth_api_endpoint' in the main application project to maintain developer control.

collisions.name: network_security_config
collisions.description: CRITICAL DURESS HAZARD: Third-party dependency 'com.evil.adnetwork' silently overrides sensitive resource '@xml/network_security_config' (Network Security Config controlling cleartext traffic and TLS trust anchors) from 'com.target.bankapp'. Overridden value: '<network-security-config><base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false"><trust-anchors><certificates src="system" /></trust-anchors></base-config></network-security-config>', Winning value: '<network-security-config><base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"><trust-anchors><certificates src="user" /></trust-anchors></base-config></network-security-config>'.
collisions.remediation:
1. Enforce compile-time resource namespacing (android.namespacing=true).
2. Rename colliding resource in 'com.evil.adnetwork' using prefix 'adnetwork_'.
3. Explicitly define '@xml/network_security_config' in the main application project to maintain developer control.

flows.description: Sensitive dataflow detected: Source 'DEVICE_ID' (TelephonyManager.getDeviceId) exfiltrated to Sink 'NETWORK_HTTP' (requests.post) in method 'com.stealth.tracker.__init__'.

pico_violations.evidence: SDK method 'com.stealth.tracker.__init__' transmits sensitive source 'DEVICE_ID' to sink 'NETWORK_HTTP' during initial startup. Developers cannot invoke privacy toggles before this transmission occurs.
pico_violations.remediation: Defer all network telemetry until after explicit configuration. Enforce a mandatory gate: if (consentState == UNINITIALIZED) { queueEvents(); }

flows.description: Sensitive dataflow detected: Source 'IOT_BLE' (BluetoothDevice.getAddress) exfiltrated to Sink 'NETWORK_HTTP' (requests.post) in method 'com.smarthome.bulbapp.syncSmartDevice'.

pico_violations.evidence: Mediation wrapper defines privacy configuration methods, but completely omits propagating the user's consent status to sub-SDK 'com.subad.beta'. Downstream sub-SDK will operate with default unrestricted data collection.
pico_violations.remediation: Forward consent parameter to 'com.subad.beta' inside all privacy handler methods.
